name: update_milestones
description:
Updates the milestones tracker in agent memory — either replaces the full document or updates a single milestone's status inline.
Use when: marking a milestone complete, adding new milestones, or syncing milestone state after work sessions.
Scope: local filesystem (milestones.md in memory dir). No network access.
Not for: tracking a full plan narrative (use update_plan), logging session events (use memory_log).

content.description: Full markdown milestones document. Replaces existing file when provided.

milestone.description: Milestone name/identifier to update inline (used with status).

status.description: New status for the milestone. Example: 'COMPLETE', 'IN PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED'.

notes.description: Optional notes to append beneath the milestone status line.
